umbrella-bioproject.title: Umbrella BioProject
umbrella-bioproject.overview: An upper-level project that groups multiple Primary BioProjects. Used for host-pathogen / multi-modal studies and the Principal / Alternate / DRA BPs of Haplotype phased assemblies.
umbrella-bioproject.prerequisites: Roles of the underlying Primary BioProjects are clearly defined. Umbrellas cannot be unpublished, while each Primary can be put on Hold.
umbrella-bioproject.outputs: Issues a PRJDB##### accession dedicated to the Umbrella (record the child BPs in Private comments to DDBJ staff).

primary-bioproject.title: Primary BioProject
primary-bioproject.overview: A metadata project created per research unit. Acts as the anchor that ties together BioSample / DRA / MSS / GEA and other DB submissions.
primary-bioproject.prerequisites: The research scope and Project data type are finalized. Mixed cases (host-pathogen, multi-modal) are split per organism / data type under an Umbrella BP.

biosample.title: BioSample
biosample.overview: Metadata per biological sample (individual, tissue, culture, environmental metagenome, etc.). Picks a Package that matches the organism and sampling method.
biosample.prerequisites: BioProject (or a placeholder ID) is issued. The GroupType determines the aggregation: one BS per Group, one BS per FASTQ row, or a derived-BS chain.
biosample.outputs: Issues a SAMD00000000 accession. Common Packages include Human, Microbe, Viral, Model organism or animal, MIMS.me, and MIMAG.

dra.title: DRA (Run / Experiment / Analysis)
dra.overview: DDBJ Sequence Read Archive. Hosts raw sequence reads (FASTQ/BAM/HDF5) and analysis products (BAM/VCF/contigs).
dra.prerequisites: BioProject + BioSample are registered (or placeholders). Library construction (Source / Strategy / Selection / Platform / Instrument) must be described.

mss.title: MSS / NSSS submission
mss.overview: Mass Submission System (MSS) and the web-based NSSS. Used to submit annotated INSDC flat files for assembled sequences (WGS / TSA / TLS / HTG / HTC).
mss.prerequisites: BioProject + BioSample are registered. Files must comply with INSDC FF format, and a locus_tag_prefix is requested at BioSample submission.
mss.outputs: Issues the assigned INSDC two-letter prefix accessions (e.g. BAxx####).

gea.title: GEA submission
gea.overview: Genomic Expression Archive. Hosts microarray, RNA-seq, and spatial transcriptomics expression data.
gea.prerequisites: BioProject + BioSample are registered. Submission Type (Sequencing / Microarray) and a sample-by-sample matrix are prepared.

metabobank.title: MetaboBank submission
metabobank.overview: Repository for metabolomics and imaging MS data. Only Study-level accessions are issued (no Run / Analysis level).
metabobank.prerequisites: BioProject + BioSample are registered. Different experimental designs are split into separate Studies grouped under one BioProject.

togovar.title: TogoVar-repository submission
togovar.overview: TogoVar repository for Japanese population / disease-associated aggregate variants. Accepts aggregate VCFs.
togovar.prerequisites: BioProject + BioSample are registered. The aggregate variation origin, study type, and sample size are described.

jga.title: JGA registration
jga.overview: The Japanese Genotype-phenotype Archive (JGA) uses its own application and submission pipeline, separate from D-way. Eight objects (Submission / Study / Sample / Experiment / Data / Analysis / Dataset / Policy) are registered in sequence in the JGA submission management system. db-portal does not host the input UI; it provides external redirection and a preparation checklist only.
jga.prerequisites: An access-controlled policy (subgrp ID) approved under DBCLS / NBDC is already issued.
jga.outputs: Issues eight prefixes: JGA / JGAS / JGAN / JGAX / JGAR / JGAZ / JGAD / JGAP.

dbcls-application.title: DBCLS Application + Policy approval
dbcls-application.overview: Mandatory prior application for JGA submissions. Obtains an access-controlled subgrp ID under the NBDC Human Data guidelines.
dbcls-application.prerequisites: Institutional requirements (privacy, informed consent) are satisfied.
dbcls-application.outputs: Obtains a subgrp ID (hum####, etc.). Not a DDBJ portal accession.

jpost.title: jPOST Repository
jpost.overview: Repository for proteomics MS data (mass-spec-domain=proteomics). Submitted directly to jPOST, not DDBJ.
jpost.prerequisites: jPOST account. BioProject is used to link the metadata.

eva.title: EVA (European Variation Archive)
eva.overview: EBI-hosted repository for open per-sample / aggregate SNP / Indel variants. Submitted directly to EVA, not DDBJ.

dgva.title: DGVa (Database of Genomic Variants archive)
dgva.overview: EBI-hosted repository for structural variants (SV) and CNV submissions.

humandbs.title: HumanDBs (post-release reference)
humandbs.overview: Reference site for hum-numbered DDBJ datasets after public release. Not a submission portal; informational only.
humandbs.prerequisites: Submission to JGA / related DBs and public release are complete.

rule02.haplotypeNote: Umbrella BioProject grouping the Principal / Alternate / DRA-shared BPs for Haplotype phased. Record the child BP accessions and roles in Private comments to DDBJ staff.
rule02.mixedLineageNote: Suggesting an Umbrella BioProject because this study contains multiple Primary BPs (host-pathogen or multi-modal design).

rule04c.studyOnly: MetaboBank issues accessions only at the Study level (MTBKSn). Split different experimental designs into separate Studies and group them under one BioProject.

rule04d.unsupportedPlatform: No Array Design is registered in GEA for this platform. Contact the DDBJ team to register a new Array Design.

dbclsApplication.notes: JGA submissions require an approved data-sharing policy under the DBCLS / NBDC framework (provider application group). Complete this application before proceeding.

jgaPrep.overview: Register eight objects (Submission / Study / Sample / Experiment / Data / Analysis / Dataset / Policy) in sequence in the JGA submission management system. db-portal does not host the input UI; the checklist below describes what to prepare for each object.
jgaPrep.submission: Submission: provider-application group (subgrp ID) linkage, contact information, release-plan summary.
jgaPrep.study: Study: title, abstract, research aim, related publications (PubMed ID / DOI).
jgaPrep.sample: Sample: one per donor. The count can be derived from the target BioSample rows. Prepare sex, age, phenotype, informed-consent conditions.
jgaPrep.experiment: Experiment: Library Strategy / Source / Selection / Instrument / Library Construction Protocol (same shape as DRA Experiment).
jgaPrep.data: Data (raw): FASTQ etc. raw sequence files. After approval, upload to the JGA server via sftp / WinSCP.
jgaPrep.analysis: Analysis: VCF / BAM analysis products, reference accession or label, and analysis-pipeline information.
jgaPrep.dataset: Dataset: the bundled list of Samples / Data / Analyses, Dataset title and abstract, linked Policy.
jgaPrep.policy: Policy: provider-application group (subgrp ID), DAC / DUO release conditions, request-review policy.

rule06b.analysisNotes: An Analysis must contain a single VCF (variation case). Aggregate analyses require prior contact with the JGA team.

rule06c.phenotypeOnlyDataset: Phenotype-only Dataset without sequencing. Sample → Dataset is connected directly, skipping Experiment / Data / Analysis.

rule07a.tpaPrimaryRequired: Record the cited primary accessions in the PRIMARY block. Non-cited regions cannot exceed 50 bp.
rule07a.locusTagPrefix: Apply for a locus_tag_prefix at BioSample registration (via the DDBJ submission desk).

rule07b.teamReviewRequired: Prior consultation with the GEA / MetaboBank team is required. Submission is disabled until the review status becomes confirmed.
rule07b.peerReviewedRequired: Peer-reviewed publication (PubMed ID / DOI) referencing the original data is mandatory (preprints not accepted).

warning.unconfirmed: Team review is not yet confirmed. Reach the team via the contact form before proceeding.

rule07c.tpaAnnotationStopped: Registration of TPA:inferential / TPA:experimental has been suspended since 2025-01.
rule07c.curatorRequired: Third-party annotation requires prior consultation with a DDBJ Curator.

warning.curatorRequired: Submission is blocked until curator consultation is completed.

rule08.rawExternalChoose: Choose the raw read registration status (external / pending / external DB).
rule08.externalDbConsult: Consult the DDBJ team before registering raw reads to an external DB.
rule08.primaryContigsNote: Register primary contigs as De Novo Assembly (not Sequence Annotation).
rule08.derivedBsNote: Derived BioSamples (binned / MAG / SAG) reference the source BS via derived_from. Use the attributed organism (no 'metagenome' suffix) as the organism name.

warning.rawPending: Raw read status is not yet selected. Choose one of the three options (external / pending / external DB) in this step.

rule08c.derivedFromNote: derived_from accepts a single accession or a range (SAMD###-SAMD###).

rule09.barcodeProtocol: Enter the barcode-sample mapping in the Library Construction Protocol field of the DRA step.

rule10c.jgaSampleNotes: When personal-identifiability is unknown, the access is provisionally set to restricted. Confirm with DDBJ Contact / DBCLS application system, then edit the access column if needed.

rule11.draSharedNote: A separate DRA-shared Primary BioProject is generated because both Haplotype-derived reads are mixed.
rule11.sharedBsNote: Principal / Alternate / DRA-shared BPs reference the same BioSample. Override the package with a MIGS variant (MIGS.eu / MIGS.ba / MIGS.vi) and share the locus_tag_prefix.

humandbs.notes: After JGA Policy is set, data is published on HumanDBs (NBDC human data archive) with a dedicated hum-numbered site.

jpost.notes: jPOST is operated as an external repository; manage BioProject / BioSample on the jPOST side.

eva.notes: Non-human SNP / Indel goes to the European Variation Archive (EVA). DDBJ portal provides only guidance.

dgva.notes: Non-human SV / CNV goes to DGVa (Database of Genomic Variants archive). DDBJ portal provides only guidance.

rule13.htgPhaseNote: HTG_PHASE0 / HTG_PHASE1 / HTG_PHASE2 are automatically appended to KEYWORDS for HTG.
rule13.keywordsReferenceNote: Add INSDC methodological keywords (~40 options) as needed. See the external link below.
